systems.system: Administration's Intranet Network (RIA), a shared government network said to have interconnected more than 500 state agencies over 15 years, with a base station in Bamako and in each regional capital except Ségou
systems.tiers: state agencies; Bamako and regional capitals

systems.system: State fibre-optic backbone (3,200 km laid by the state), with an urban GPON network and some 50 GPON terminals interconnecting government institutions, and a VSAT system of about 50 sites
systems.tiers: 29 of 57 circles and 130 of 704 secondary administrative cities not connected (consultant's analysis of AMRTP data, 2021)

systems.system: National data centre, not fully operational and used by only a few state agencies
Civil registration system, managed jointly by local governments and the Ministry of Territorial Administration and Decentralization
Integrated Human Resources Management System for the Public Service of the State and Local Authorities, a project launched in May 2022

systems.owner: Ministry of Territorial Administration and Decentralization

note: The government network is described as linking state agencies and regional capitals; no commune or other local government office is said to be on it, and the backbone figures count localities reached, not offices connected. AGETIC is said to train around 3,000 government and local authority officials a year (capacity).
